top_categories.workout_context: 110ft/mi means long efforts at or near FTP on every climb. If your threshold cracks at minute 15, you'll walk the rest.
At The Majestics Gravel, surges push you above threshold and you have to recover while still riding. Over-unders train exactly that.
7,546ft of climbing means repeated surges above threshold. VO2max work is how you survive the fifth climb, not just the first.
7,546ft of climbing on grades that change every minute. You need to switch from seated to standing without losing rhythm.
The Majestics Gravel's Swiss Alps, Alpine gravel forces constant power changes. Surge over the rough stuff, settle on the smooth, repeat for 68 miles.
Race-pace efforts that mimic The Majestics Gravel's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before July.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of The Majestics Gravel. Train it until it feels boring.
Low-cadence force work for 7,546ft of climbing. The slow, grinding ascents where you can't spin—you push.
68 miles on swiss Alpine gravel burns energy faster than the distance suggests. Train the fade resistance now.
How long can you hold 105% FTP before you blow? At The Majestics Gravel, that number decides whether you bridge or get dropped.
Base fitness for The Majestics Gravel. Without this, the hard workouts break you down instead of building you up.
Short, max efforts are unavoidable. Punchy climbs, gap closures, attacks on swiss Alpine gravel. If you haven't trained them, you'll crack.

race_overlay.nutrition: Target 40–60g carbs/hour for The Majestics Gravel’s 68 miles. Front-load calories in the first half. One bottle per hour minimum; adjust for conditions and sweat rate.
race_overlay.altitude: Moderate altitude at The Majestics Gravel. Arrive 2–3 days early. Reduce intensity expectations by 5–10%. Hydrate aggressively.
race_overlay.terrain: Mixed terrain at The Majestics Gravel requires surface adaptability. Include weekly rides on swiss alpine gravel to build confidence. Expect: swiss alps, alpine gravel, regional event.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on TT Threshold, Over Under, and VO2max to prepare you for 68 miles of swiss alpine gravel in Aigle to Villars-sur-Ollon, Switzerland.
